name: google-shopping-for-shop
description: Puts your shop on Google Shopping. Serves a product feed for Google Merchant Center in which every variation is its own listing - its own price, photos, stock and link - grouped under its parent product, so a search for the exact size and colour someone wants finds the exact size and colour you sell. Give Google the feed address once and it keeps itself up to date; brand and barcode details can be set per product, and anything you would rather keep off Google can sit the feed out.
